title: OTWD record type registry
description: The format of record-types.json, the published registry of record types, and of the GET /v1/record-types response. A record type's code is the kind segment of its public IDs. The registry is open: a minor version can add a record type, and a consumer skips records, changes and bulk downloads of a record type it does not know. A record type is never renamed, reused or removed. Adding one needs an ADR.

version.description: Version of the registry. A new record type increases the minor version.

language.description: Language of the labels and descriptions: en-AU, the reference language.

code.description: The record type's code, also the kind segment of its public IDs, for example road_segment in otwd:road_segment:01KX3QJ1A4C6E8G0J2K4M6P8RT.

status.description: active: served and accepted in submissions. deprecated: still served, no longer accepted in submissions that create one.

geometry.description: point: a location fact (latitude and longitude). line: a geometry fact (GeoJSON LineString or MultiLineString).

full_schema.description: The schema of the full form, relative to this file.

compact_schema.description: The schema of the compact form, relative to this file.

repository_schema.description: The schema of the repository form, the record as its data repository file holds it (ADR 0046), relative to this file.

collection.description: The API path that lists records of this type.

creation_kind.description: The submission kind that creates a record of this type.

computed_facts.description: Facts OTWD computes for this record type and contributors never submit, such as a site's fire district.

introduced_in.description: The schema version that added the record type.

adr.description: The ADR that added the record type, relative to the repository root.
